ct_hsip.title: CTDOT Highway Safety Improvement Program Implementation Plan FY2027

hsm.title: Highway Safety Manual
hsm.decided: critical rate against the corridor's own sites (user, #34 item 7, docs/03); used in every state until that state's own screening is built

crash_costs.dollar_year: not stated (CRSMS indexes to recent CPI/ECI)
crash_costs.page: Appendix A, Table A-2 'EPDO Crash Costs by Severity' (comprehensive cost), p. A-19 (PDF p. 69); same table B-2 p. 87, C-4 p. 127
rules: one cost per KABCO level (crash severity), every location type

statewide_rates.missing: CTDOT's critical crash rate uses a weighted statewide average inside CRSMS (HSIP Implementation Plan FY2027, p. A-20), but no statewide average-rate table is published there, and CrashIQ has no Connecticut traffic counts

screening.state_method: CRSMS network screening: excess expected crash frequency with SPFs, level of service of safety, EPDO average crash frequency and critical crash rate (HSIP Implementation Plan FY2027, Table A-1, p. A-15)

min_years.missing: the FY2027 plan screens 5 years (2020-2024) but states no minimum

spf_calibration.missing: CRSMS uses Connecticut SPFs; no calibration table in the FY2027 plan, and CrashIQ has no SPF engine
